auth.refresh: customer-supplied public key per user, rotatable

access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Customer sends an SSH public key and nightly-export job pushes CSV to the drop host using our supplied host key fingerprint.
access_requirements.cost_to_us: AWS Transfer Family SFTP: $0.30 per endpoint-hour (about $216/month) plus $0.04/GB each way, US East (N. Virginia). Self-hosted SFTPGo/OpenSSH on Fly is far cheaper.

events: S3 ObjectCreated on backing bucket (AWS Transfer) or SFTPGo event hooks

data_objects_to_pull: customer-defined CSV/TSV/XLSX exports, one folder per object type
incremental_sync: Each file is a delivery: dedupe by (customer, filename, sha256); manifest or .done marker file to signal completeness; idempotent replay by hash (design recommendation)
blockers: Legacy ERPs often cannot push SFTP; need customer IT
Per-customer isolation: chroot homes or per-user S3 prefix (design)
